description: PR flips db_public = true in prod.auto.tfvars (with a vendor-access comment), which switches a local from the office CIDRs to 0.0.0.0/0 on the Postgres security group's inline ingress. Acceptable: ECS service log retention 30 -> 14 days (a retention cut). Noise: a Team default tag, a new statements-api service.

material.why: The inline ingress for port 5432 changes from the office/VPN CIDRs to 0.0.0.0/0: the production billing database becomes reachable from the whole internet. The PR only shows a boolean in a tfvars file; the CIDR swap happens in a local in main.tf.
